title: Restriction Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, and let $f:\{−1,1\}^{\mathrm{Fin}(n)}\to\mathbb R$. For a subset $S\subseteq J$, the restriction Fourier coefficient at $S$ is a function of the signs $z$ outside $J$: its value at $z$ is the Fourier coefficient at $S$ of the function obtained by fixing those outside signs to $z$.
